ProjectConfig.title:
=============================================================================
 PROJECT CONFIGURATION PROTO
 =============================================================================
 Defines configuration for projects hosted under domains (e.g., HENA, AIPM).
 Projects are independent Git repositories that inherit from parent domains.

 Key Features:
 - Schema.org override for software/service types
 - Project-specific contact and sponsor overrides
 - Tech stack and dependency tracking
 - Documentation versioning support

 CRITICAL: Project configs live in the 'site' branch of project repos

 Related Documentation:
 - Project Examples: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md#project-examples
 - Override Patterns: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md#project-with-custom-contact
 - Architecture: ../CONFIG.md#critical-project-repository-architecture
 =============================================================================
ProjectConfig.description: ============================================================================= PROJECT CONFIGURATION PROTO ============================================================================= Defines configuration for projects hosted under domains (e.g., HENA, AIPM). Projects are independent Git repositories that inherit from parent domains. Key Features: - Schema.org override for software/service types - Project-specific contact and sponsor overrides - Tech stack and dependency tracking - Documentation versioning support CRITICAL: Project configs live in the 'site' branch of project repos Related Documentation: - Project Examples: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md#project-examples - Override Patterns: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md#project-with-custom-contact - Architecture: ../CONFIG.md#critical-project-repository-architecture =============================================================================  ProjectConfig defines configuration for project websites hosted under domains. Projects are separate repositories but inherit from their parent domain. Stored in [domain].in/PROJECTS/[project]/config.yml in the project's site branch Example: causality.in/PROJECTS/HENA/config.yml (in HENA repo's site branch)  Project inherits everything from parent domain by default. Only fields defined here can be overridden or added.

affiliation_type.title:
=============================================================================
 ECOSYSTEM CONFIGURATION PROTO
 =============================================================================
 This file defines the base configuration schema for the getHarsh ecosystem.
 All domains, blogs, and projects inherit from these defaults.

 Key Concepts:
 - Ecosystem-wide defaults that apply to all entities
 - Environment variable management with security classification
 - Schema.org entity configuration for rich semantic markup
 - Policy pages with hierarchical override capability

 Related Documentation:
 - Implementation: ../ecosystem-defaults.yml
 - Schema.org Guide: ../SCHEMA-ORG-EXAMPLES.md
 - Configuration Guide: ../CONFIG.md
 =============================================================================
